answer: A farm faking 430 aliases needs 430 separate masthead listings, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Editorial board tenure with journal masthead listings is the check: a name on one journal's masthead issue after issue. The plume check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The jade record is public, the sable cost is per identity, and 430 aliases cost 430 times one honest seat.
